values.note: 115 packed-gravel water/electric sites, several taking RVs up to 40 ft, plus six hammock/tent sites. The 15 equestrian sites may only be reserved by guests with a horse.

sites.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/kings-mountain/camping ('Standard Sites with Elec. & Water: 115 sites'; 'Several sites accommodate RVs up to 40 feet') + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/kings-mountain/campsites ('Equestrian Campsites ... may only be reserved by guests accompanied by a horse'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/kings-mountain/camping ('restroom facilities with hot showers'; 'Dump Station: Yes'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked on South Carolina State Parks' own reservation site or 1-866-345-7275, up to 13 months ahead. 'Minimum length of stay is 2 nights'; per AWH's firsthand report on the state:SC row, a single night can be booked by calling the park within a week of arrival. Maximum 14 nights consecutive, then 7 nights away. Same-day reservations go through the park (803-222-3209). Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.
